subject: Deploy Doré Design 1.6 complete main-site Journal inside Design
body: Pull merged PR #268 / merge 29d2791bb5e63e55481066c3da45fac35ae18a5b. Preserve the locked #262 homepage exactly. Deploy Doré Design 1.6 so clicking either Journal link on the front door opens /journal/, which must render the complete Hugo-built main-site Vol.00 reading experience, including Opening, Contents and the full reading flow. Preserve the former Journal index at /journal-index/. Verify /journal/ contains vol-00-proclamation, contents and movement-watch markers, includes navigation back to Front Door and /editor, and that /api/health reports version 1.6 with journal_mode=full-main-site-journal-in-design. Return exact deployment and acceptance evidence.
